name: KpiDashboard
purpose: Arranges a set of key performance indicators in a responsive metric grid.

items.description: Array of { id, label, value, trend? } metrics.

label.description: Accessible label for the dashboard region.

antiPatterns: Do not exceed eight KPI tiles in one dashboard.
Do not mix unrelated units without labeling each tile.

a11y.focus: Tiles are not focusable unless they contain actions.
a11y.labeling: Region label names the dashboard; each metric is a group.

responsive.strategy: Root sets container-type: inline-size; the grid is mobile-first compact (one column) and steps up via @container at token-equal rem thresholds. Not viewport @media.

rtl.strategy: Logical CSS only. Direction inherits from document lang/dir.
